steps.label: 2118-master-qa-complete-select-approved
command: (() => {const fs=document.getElementById('statusFields'),p=document.querySelector('.omr-preview-btn');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089216'||!fs.disabled||fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag]:checked').value!=='R'||p.dataset.questionType!=='OBSACN')throw Error('Expected own complete objective draft');const data={omr:JSON.parse(p.getAttribute('data-saved-omr')||'null'),answer:JSON.parse(p.getAttribute('data-saved-answer')||'null')},message=OmrValidate.checkData('OBSACN',data);if(message)throw Error('Saved OMR failed actual validator: '+message);document.querySelector('[data-status-edit]').click();const y=fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag][value=Y]');if(fs.disabled||y.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Approval transition unavailable');y.click();return {action:'Select approved-use on actual complete QA status form',selected:fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag]:checked').value,omrValidation:message||null};})()

steps.label: 2119-master-qa-complete-save-confirm-open
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089216'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Expected own status editing page');const m=document.getElementById('statusSaveModal');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Status-save modal did not finish opening')),5000);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});document.querySelector('[data-status-save]').click();});return {modalId:m.id,text:m.innerText};})()
